Spacecraft: NASA 3D Resources
https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources
ISS (B), Space Shuttle (A), Voyager Probe (A).
These historical 3D models are arranged for exploration, not current mission positions.
Object sizes and distances are adjusted for viewing. Shuttle is a historical vehicle.
Moon map: Three.js r170 examples/textures/planets/moon_1024.jpg.
GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader, BufferGeometryUtils: Three.js r170 (MIT).
Draco decoder: Google Draco distributed with Three.js (Apache 2.0).
